start.bodyText:
ON A SLOPE, CUT FROM CARD AT 1:100. SCROLL DOWN TO THE LITTLE FIGURE.

ABOVE THE GARDEN
35.6 CM
ON THE DESK // 1:100
35.6 M
IN THE HOUSE // 1:1

A CENTIMETRE OF CARD IS A METRE OF HOUSE.

DATUM +0.16M
EYE HEIGHT 16 MM // 1:100
SCALE 1:100 → 1:1
SCAN R 0.0M

THEN THE CARD
BECOMES THE HOUSE.

LEVEL ±0.00M // LIVING
THE LIVING ROOM
6.40 M TO THE CEILING. OAK FLOOR, BOARD-MARKED CONCRETE, THE SOUTH WALL ALL GLASS.
LEVEL +3.20M // STUDY
THE STUDY
+3.20, OVER THE LIVING ROOM. THE MODEL IS STILL ON THE DESK.

AND BACK TO THE DESK.

SCROLL TO SHRINK
A white card model of a house on a slope, on an architect's desk at night
Down to the height of the scale figure
Then the card becomes the house, and the desk lamp becomes the sun
Through the big glass into the living room, and up to the study
And back to the desk
Start a project

ATELIER 1:100
HOUSES ON DIFFICULT SITES

EVERY HOUSE WE BUILD
STARTS ON THIS DESK.

SEND US THE SITE AND WHAT YOU NEED FROM IT. WE START IN CARD, UNDER A LAMP, AND THE MODEL STAYS ON THE DESK UNTIL THE HOUSE IS BUILT.

START A PROJECT
SEE THE HOUSES
WRITE TO THE STUDIO
HOUSE ON A SLOPE, 2026
MODEL AT 1:100, MOUNT BOARD AND GREYBOARD
THE STUDIO IS OPEN MONDAY TO FRIDAY
